I saved the new release process (`make release`, which tags and publishes) to project memory. It replaces the old memory that said to push a `vYYYY.MM.N` tag by hand.

The `Makefile` here doesn't have a `release` target yet; it only has `test` and `test-fast`. Maybe the change is on a branch that hasn't been merged, or it lives in another repo. Until a `release` target is added, `make release` will fail in this checkout. Do you want me to add one, or is it coming from somewhere else?
